name: Arlysia, City Entrance
desc1: The western entrance to Arlysia has light, but steady traffic as
desc2: people head to the docks and back. Despite the problems that seem to
desc3: plague everyone else, the fishermen of Arlysia are steadfast in their
desc4: daily lives. To the east is the local market and several small shops.
desc5: To the north and south of you is Seaside Way.
